answer.rationale: Competitor price cut creates immediate churn risk in SMB segment. Memory_73 confirms targeted promotional pricing delivers strong acquisition and revenue lift for price-sensitive SMB accounts—this is the most direct tactical response. Memory_57 shows referral incentives work in established customers but won't address acute price-driven churn risk this week. Simplify_onboarding (memory_86) and activation_messaging (memory_91) drive engagement and retention but don't directly address price competition. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is misaligned—competitor threat is SMB-focused. Standard_experiment scale allows rapid deployment to at-risk SMB cohorts while limiting downside exposure to full-margin compression. Promotional pricing carries downstream risk of training price-sensitive buyers and margin erosion, but preserves optionality to layer onboarding simplification and activation messaging afterward if churn stabilizes. This sequence prioritizes immediate revenue defense while maintaining ability to drive long-term value metrics.
